subject: [AMBER] Saving a frame of a trajectory in pdbqt format.

messages.author: saverio lemme
messages.body:
Dear Amber Users,
it is possible to save a frame of a trajectory of a receptor,
having the .prmtop and .nc  files, in pdbqt format
instead of pdb?
Thanks.
Saverio

messages.author: Daniel Roe
messages.body:
Hi,
I’m assuming you are talking about the AutoDock format. Unfortunately
CPPTRAJ does not currently support this format.
-Dan
